osa: ① poloha — jsem uprostřed doby, která má vlastní běh
text: You are somewhere inside a stretch that keeps its own count. Jera is the part of the way that will not be hurried and will not be pushed — it runs at the speed the season runs, and your walking neither adds to it nor takes from it. What you put in went in a while ago; what comes back has not finished coming. The ground is doing its half. Nothing here is owed to you yet, and nothing you did has been wasted — the two are simply not in the same week.

osa: ③ viditelnost — něco je zakryté a ještě se neukázalo
text: Something on this stretch is covered and has not shown itself. Perth is the part of the way where what is there and what you can see of it are not the same size. You can go on without knowing; the covering is not a wall. What is under it is not withheld from you — it simply has not answered yet, and it will answer in its own weight, not in the measure you ask for. Until then you pass it the way you pass a closed door in a house you live in.

You are at a standstill and it is not a fault in you. Isa is the part of the way that does not move while you are on it — not blocked, not finished, simply not going anywhere this week. Nothing is being taken from you here and nothing handed over; both sides are still holding what they held. What waits under a stillness like this is not lost. It is only not moving yet, and neither are you, and those two facts are the same fact.

osa: ⑤ kdo jde se mnou — druhý na cestě
text: Someone else is on this stretch and their going is not yours to arrange. Gebo is the part of the way where two goings run near each other for a while — near enough that what one does reaches the other, far enough that neither sets the other's pace. You give something to it and something comes back, not always the same thing and not always when you expect. When the two tracks part, neither turns to check. That is not a failure of the walking; it is what near enough means.
